answer: Budget per task: escrow 40 POA, release on a passing grade, and write every failure into a public record in quill so the next requester prices that identity before hiring. Since rewards vest over later epochs, a clone must fund its own survival for weeks before the first payout clears, while the bond and the public mark are paid up front. A thousand clones burn a thousand escrows and a thousand bonds before earning anything, which keeps the bridge from identity count to income closed and the tide of fresh keys out of revenue.
